verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a cloud email service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to disable vendor telemetry or usage tracking. The optional event publishing and monitoring features are adjacent sending-metrics capabilities, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
